The tapestries in the vault depict the heroes of
the Galar region’s past.\c
I suppose if we’ve got any modern hero, it’d have
to be our Champion, Leon.[VAR 0114(0017)]

Listen up, [VAR 0100(0000)].\c
Your goal is to defeat that superstar Leon.
So go conquer Route 6 and train yourself up
along the way to Stow-on-Side![VAR 0114(0017)]
